BiblicalUsage: En-Dor is a place in Palestine. In Joshua 17:11, the text says "and the inhabitants of En-dor and her towns." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Dor matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Dor is one of them.
